about.en: MVL (Mass Vehicle Ledger) is a mobility blockchain ecosystem that records vehicle and driving data and rewards drivers and riders, linked to the TADA ride-hailing service in Southeast Asia. MVL is the ERC-20 at 0xA849EaaE994fb86Afa73382e9Bd88c2B6b18Dc71 on Ethereum, with deployments on BNB Chain and TON.
